items.title: Phronix: The Capability-Centric Learning Paradigm for Agents
items.summary: arXiv:2610.31789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scientific computing increasingly relies on large language model-based agents for performance engineering tasks such as instrumentation, analysis, and workflow porting. However, agent effectiveness depends heavily on the surrounding harness, which typically relies on manually written skills and curated memory. This limits autonomous learning, forcing agents to repeatedly rediscover solutions rather than retain and reuse knowledge from prior executi
items.summary_zh: Phronix 提出以能力为中心的学习范式，让 Agent 自主获取技能与记忆，减少人工编写的依赖
items.why_zh: Agent 自主学习与能力获取；可复用：构建以能力为中心的训练循环，自动生成技能库

items.title: Knowledge Graphs Quality Assessment in the Era of LLMs: A Conceptual Framework
items.summary: arXiv:2610.31684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) have been popularized during the last few decades and are increasingly constructed and consumed by Large Language Models (LLMs). Various applications therefore rely on KGs to provide concise, complete, accurate, faithful, fresh, and traceable answers. However, what is the quality of those KGs? In which cases should a KG be used, and can it be trusted to ground an LLM? How might it be evaluated? We reviewed the literature on q
items.summary_zh: 提出面向 LLM 时代的知识图谱质量评估概念框架，明确完整性、准确性等维度
items.why_zh: KG 质量评估与 LLM 融合；可复用：建立多维指标体系指导数据清洗

items.title: Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X, a 14B Open DNA Language Model that Brings DNA and Natural Language Together for the First Time
items.summary: Hugging Face released Carbon-X, an open 14.8B DNA language model built on Qwen3-14B. It reads raw DNA in chat, answers in English, and averages 66.7% across 5 DNA benchmarks under Apache 2.0. The post Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X, a 14B Open DNA Language Model that Brings DNA and Natural Language Together for the First Time appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Hugging Face 发布开源 DNA 语言模型 Carbon-X，基于 Qwen3-14B，支持原始 DNA 序列读取与自然语言交互。
items.why_zh: 多模态大模型微调，学习如何将特定领域数据（如 DNA 序列）适配到基础 LLM 架构及基准测试方法。

items.title: Hunt bugs with your dot

Get started with dots today: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/dots
